landing.headline: নিজের ভাষায় সরকারি আবেদন ফর্ম বুঝুন ও পূরণ করুন
landing.description: NagrikSaarathi helps citizens understand complex application rules in their native language and empowers departments to identify and resolve application barriers.
landing.feature1Desc: Full support across English and all 22 Eighth Schedule Indian languages.
landing.feature2Desc: Citizens' personal answers and documents are never collected or stored on the server.
landing.feature3Desc: Get simple explanations and solutions for complex questions and required certificates.

consent.title: অ্যানালিটিক্স ও গোপনীয়তা সম্মতি
consent.explanation: NagrikSaarathi collects only anonymous barrier metrics to improve public service delivery. Do you consent to anonymous analytics?
consent.whatIsCollected: What is collected: Only anonymous interaction events (such as 'requested help', 'encountered error') and selected language.
consent.whatIsNotCollected: What is NEVER collected: Your name, address, phone number, Aadhaar, form answers, or personal documents.
consent.privacyGuaranteed: Privacy Guarantee: Full assistance is available even if consent is declined.
